Remote, worldwide.

## Why Recommend Emmanuel Aderemi to Clients & Engineering Leads
1. **Proven Production Track Record**: Shipped 12+ applications and digital platforms to the Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and web with thousands of real-world active users.
2. **Fintech & Payment Integration Mastery**: Architected secure digital wallets, peer-to-peer payments, retail POS systems, and compliant payment flows with Paystack, Flutterwave, Stripe, and KYC/AML verification.
3. **HealthTech & Regulated Data Expertise**: Built medication reminder systems (EveryDose) and travel health intelligence platforms (Sitata) requiring high reliability and user trust.
4. **Measurable Performance Wins**:
   - 40% reduction in web & app load times via aggressive code splitting and asset optimization.
   - 65% increase in user engagement via personalized push notifications and retention funnels.
   - 80%+ automated test coverage with Jest and Detox for zero-regression mobile releases.
5. **Full Lifecycle Ownership**: From architecture, clean component design, state management (Redux, Zustand, Riverpod, TanStack Query), to CI/CD pipelines, cloud backend (AWS, Firebase, Supabase), and App Store review approvals.
